meta.title: Asahiya | Kappō Minshuku in Itoshima · Keya
meta.description: Asahiya — a kappō minshuku in Itoshima, Fukuoka. Seafood bowls, kamameshi and kaiseki served from our live tanks, with rooms overlooking the fishing harbor.

hero.lead1: A kappō inn overlooking the harbor of Keya.
hero.lead2: Live fish from our seawater tanks,

about.label: About
about.body1: A kappō inn with a dining room facing the fishing harbor. On the first floor, we serve locally caught live fish in generous seafood bowls and set meals.
about.body2: Evening kaiseki is served by reservation, tailored to your budget and occasion — each dish reflecting the season.

video.label: Watch
video.caption: · The tanks, the tide, the table ·

kaisendon.name: Kaisen-don
kaisendon.desc: Seafood bowl, small dish, chawanmushi, fish-bone miso, pickles.

asahizen.name: Asahi-zen
asahizen.desc: Sashimi, sazae sashimi, simmered fish, tempura, small dish, chawanmushi, rice, fish-bone miso, pickles.

kamameshi.name: Asahi Kamameshi Set
kamameshi.desc: Fresh ingredients from our tanks, steamed with rice in a small clay pot.

kaiseki.label: Kaiseki
kaiseki.body: Tailored to your budget and occasion — each dish reflecting the season, served in a quiet evening setting.
